does: Updates one status machine: adds the statuses requested since the last update (entering them), then processes its lifetimes and removals.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll exports esv::StatusMachine::Update(GameTime const&); this function takes the StatusMachine and the game time and drains the pending list at +0xE0. The macOS build's symbols do not hold the name.
